plain: Opening or closing a Disclosure no longer makes the rows below jump, so delete any override of its inline gap or .overflow-hidden you added as a workaround.

steps.plain: Disclosure's panel now stays in the DOM while closed (zero height, visibility hidden) and its wrapper is a plain div, so a test that expects closed content to be absent should check it is not visible instead, and a selector on the Stack data attributes needs updating.
Timeline renders a Disclosure, so its closed panels stay in the DOM too; check a test that expects them to be absent, or a selector on the Stack data attributes.
